# Brand identity

## Our dual nature

POPCORN-NCD balances two complementary identities:

### Whimsical & accessible
- **Name:** POPCORN is a playful acronym that makes complex science approachable
- **AI team member:** "Kernel" - our AI assistant is acknowledged as part of the team
- **Voice:** Friendly, collaborative, inclusive
- **Visual accents:** The peach/chardonnay accent colour (#fdc882) adds warmth

### Serious & professional
- **Foundation:** Rigorous epidemiological simulation science
- **Credibility:** Professional colour palette, clear typography, clean layouts
- **Authority:** Evidence-based methodology, international expert collaboration
- **Visual tone:** Cool slate colours convey stability and expertise

**Key principle:** We're serious scientists who believe accessible communication strengthens research impact.

---

# Colour palette

## Primary colours

:::{.color-palette}
| Colour | Hex | Usage |
|--------|-----|-------|
| **Dark slate** | `#262c3a` | Primary text, headings, completed states |
| **Mid slate** | `#424b5e` | Secondary elements, borders |
| **Light slate** | `#8892a0` | Tertiary text, inactive states |
| **Peach accent** | `#fdc882` | Highlights, in-progress states, visual interest |
| **Bright blue** | `#2ea6cc` | Links, interactive elements |
:::

## Colour usage guidelines

### Text hierarchy
- **Primary text:** `#262c3a` (dark slate) - body copy, main headings
- **Secondary text:** `#8892a0` (light slate) - captions, inactive labels
- **Links:** `#2ea6cc` (bright blue) - clearly distinguishable for accessibility

### Interactive states
- **Completed/success:** `#262c3a` (dark slate) with white text
- **In progress/active:** `#fdc882` (peach) with dark slate text
- **Inactive/future:** White background with light grey border `#d0d5db`

### Visual accents
- Use peach (`#fdc882`) sparingly as a highlight colour
- Reserve for:
  - Current step indicators
  - Call-to-action backgrounds
  - Section dividers
  - Emphasis markers

# Typography

## Font families

We use three Google Font families:

### Headings

**H1 (Page titles)**
- Font: Montserrat
- Weight: 300 (Light)
- Colour: `#262c3a`
- Usage: Single page title per page

**H2, H3, H4, H5 (Section headings)**
- Font: Libre Baskerville
- Weight: 300 (Light)
- Colour: `#262c3a`
- Usage: Content hierarchy, serif provides classic academic feel

### Body text

**Paragraphs, lists, navigation**
- Font: Hanken Grotesk
- Weight: 300 (Light) for body, 400 (Regular) for emphasis
- Colour: `#262c3a`
- Usage: All body content, highly readable sans-serif

### Accents

**Special emphasis** (`.bam` class)
- Font: Montserrat
- Weight: 300 (Light), 400 (Regular), 500 (Medium)
- Usage: Callouts, labels, special formatted content

## Typography hierarchy

```css
h1 { font-family: Montserrat; font-weight: 300; }
h2, h3, h4, h5 { font-family: Libre Baskerville; font-weight: 300; }
p, ul, ol, li { font-family: Hanken Grotesk; font-weight: 300; }
```

## Font loading

Fonts are loaded via single Google Fonts import for optimal performance:

```css
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Libre+Baskerville:wght@300;400;700&family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@200;300;400&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap");
```

# Layout & spacing

## Content width

- **Default content area:** 850px (Quarto default)
- **Wide content area:** 1000px (15% wider, used for index page)
- **Rationale:** 1000px provides better balance for wide components like the project timeline while maintaining readability

```scss
.page-columns .content {
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
```

## Spacing system

### Vertical rhythm
- Section spacing: `3rem` (48px)
- Paragraph spacing: Default Quarto (1em)
- List spacing: Tight for related items, standard for distinct items

### Horizontal spacing
- Content padding: `1.5rem` (24px) for components
- Gap between elements: `1rem` - `1.5rem` depending on relationship
- Tight grouping: `0.5rem` (8px) for closely related items

## Responsive breakpoints

```scss
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  // Switch to single-column layouts
  // Reduce spacing to conserve vertical space
  // Adjust timeline from horizontal to vertical
}
```

# Components

## Project status timeline

A custom horizontal stepper showing project phases:

### Visual design
- **Circles:** 50px diameter, 4px border
- **Numbers:** 1.2em, font-weight 900
- **Progress line:** 4px height, connects circle centres
- **Labels:** Max 180px width, centred, 0.9rem text

### States

**Completed**
```scss
background: #3d4555;
border-color: #3d4555;
color: white;
label-color: #3d4555;
label-weight: 700;
```

**In progress**
```scss
background: #fdc882;
border-color: #fdc882;
color: #3d4555;
box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(253, 200, 130, 0.25);
label-color: #3d4555;
label-weight: 800;
```

**Inactive/future**
```scss
background: white;
border-color: #d0d5db;
color: #262c3a;
label-color: #8892a0;
label-weight: normal;
```

### Responsive behaviour
- Desktop: Horizontal layout with connecting line
- Mobile (< 768px): Vertical layout with left-aligned labels

## Team member list

Clean two-column grid layout:

### Desktop layout
```scss
grid-template-columns: 250px 1fr;
gap: 1.25rem;
border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
```

### Mobile layout
- Switches to single column
- Reduces gap to `0.5rem`

### Typography
- **Name:** Font-weight 700 (bold)
- **Credentials:** 0.9em, `#6c757d` (muted)
- **Affiliation/role:** Italic
- **Links:** 0.9em with `1rem` spacing between items

## Status banners

Coloured left-border boxes for phase indicators:

```scss
padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
margin: 1.5rem 0;
border-left: 4px solid;
border-radius: 4px;
```

### Colour schemes
- **Phase 1 (complete):** `#e8f5e9` background, `#4caf50` border
- **Phase 2 (current):** `#e3f2fd` background, `#2196f3` border
- **Phase 3 (planned):** `#fff3e0` background, `#ff9800` border

## Call-to-action boxes

```scss
border: 2px solid #2196f3;
border-radius: 8px;
padding: 1.5rem;
background-color: #f8f9fa;
```

**Button style:**
```scss
background-color: #2196f3;
color: white;
padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
border-radius: 4px;
font-weight: 600;
```

# Writing style

## Voice & tone

### General principles
- **Active voice:** Prefer direct, clear statements
- **Plain language:** Avoid jargon when possible; define technical terms
- **Inclusive:** "We" and "our" to include readers in the research community
- **Confident but humble:** Acknowledge limitations and uncertainties

### Examples

**Good:** "We're developing reporting guidelines through international consensus."

**Avoid:** "Reporting guidelines are being developed utilizing a multi-phase international consensus-building methodology."

## Spelling

Use **Canadian English** spelling throughout:
- behaviour (not behavior)
- colour (not color)
- centre (not center)
- analyse (not analyze)

## Heading capitalization

Follow **sentence case** for all headings except the document title:

- **Level 1 (title):** Title Case
- **Level 2+:** Sentence case (capitalize only first word and proper nouns)

**Examples:**
- ✓ `## Our approach to simulation science`
- ✗ `## Our Approach to Simulation Science`

# Accessibility

## Colour contrast

All colour combinations meet WCAG AA standards:

- Dark slate on white: 12.48:1 (AAA)
- Light slate on white: 4.58:1 (AA)
- Links (bright blue) on white: 4.51:1 (AA)
- Dark slate on peach: 8.11:1 (AAA)

## Typography

- Minimum body text: 16px (1rem)
- Line height: Default 1.5 for body text
- Font weights: Avoid ultra-light weights (all body text ≥ 300)

## Interactive elements

- Links clearly distinguishable by colour and underline on hover
- Buttons have adequate padding for touch targets (min 44x44px)
- Focus states visible for keyboard navigation

# Implementation notes

## File structure

```
popcorn-web/
├── assets/
│   ├── popcorn.scss          # Core typography and base styles
│   ├── popcorn-web.scss      # Component styles and layouts
│   └── team/                 # Team member photos
├── development/
│   ├── brand-style-guide.qmd # This document
│   └── [other dev docs]
└── [qmd pages]
```

## SCSS organization

### `popcorn.scss`
- Font imports
- Typography definitions (h1-h5, p, ul, ol)
- Base colour variables
- Legacy layout components (kept for backwards compatibility)

### `popcorn-web.scss`
- Page-specific layouts (content width, team page)
- Interactive components (timeline, status banners)
- Responsive breakpoints
- Modern component styles

## Maintenance

### When adding new components

1. **Check existing patterns first** - Reuse status banners, spacing, colours
2. **Use established colours** - Don't introduce new colours without reason
3. **Follow spacing system** - Use 0.5rem, 1rem, 1.5rem, 3rem increments
4. **Test responsively** - Check mobile behaviour at 768px breakpoint
5. **Maintain accessibility** - Check colour contrast, touch targets

### When updating colours

1. **Update SCSS variables** in `popcorn.scss` first
2. **Check all component usage** - Grep for hex codes
3. **Test contrast ratios** - Use WebAIM or browser DevTools
4. **Update this guide** - Keep documentation synchronized
